terms.definition: Many small alkene monomers join to form a very large molecule; the double bond opens up.
terms.examiner: Separate Chemistry. The repeating unit has the same atoms as the monomer.

terms.definition: A small molecule that joins with others to form a polymer.
terms.examiner: Ethene is the monomer of poly(ethene).

terms.definition: Monomers with two functional groups join, losing a small molecule such as water each time.
Contain an amino group and a carboxylic acid group; they polymerise to form polypeptides and proteins.
terms.examiner: Separate Chemistry, higher tier for the reaction.

terms.definition: DNA (made of nucleotides), proteins (amino acids), starch and cellulose (sugars).
